llms.body:
# Healthgrades

> Healthgrades helps people find and connect with the right doctor, hospital, and care - including ratings, reviews, and quality awards based on publicly available CMS data.

## Find Care

- [Find a Doctor](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-doctor): Search physicians by specialty, condition, or location
- [Find a Hospital](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-hospital): Hospital quality ratings and awards
- [Find a Group Practice](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-group-practice)
- [Find Urgent Care](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-an-urgent-care)
- [Find a Pharmacy](https://www.healthgrades.com/find-a-pharmacy)
- [Online Care](https://www.healthgrades.com/online-care): Telehealth options
- [Specialty Directory](https://www.healthgrades.com/specialty-directory): Index of every medical specialty directory
- [Insurance Search](https://www.healthgrades.com/insurance-search): Find in-network providers
- [Healthgrades Sitemap](https://www.healthgrades.com/sitemap): HTML index of top-level destinations

## Quality and Awards

- [Hospital Ratings and Awards](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/hospital-ratings-awards): Overview of hospital quality recognition
- [America's Best Hospitals](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/americas-best-hospitals)
- [Specialty Excellence - America's Best Care](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/specialty-excellence-americas-best-care)
- [Patient Safety Excellence Award](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/patient-safety-excellence-award)
- [Outstanding Patient Experience Award](https://www.healthgrades.com/quality/outstanding-patient-experience-award)
- [Healthgrades Methodologies](https://www.healthgrades.com/about/healthgrades-methodologies): How ratings, awards, and recognitions are calculated
- [Doctor Reviews](https://www.healthgrades.com/doctor-reviews): How patient reviews work

## Health Content

- [Conditions A-Z](https://www.healthgrades.com/conditions): Index of consumer-facing condition pages
- [Procedures A-Z](https://www.healthgrades.com/procedures): Index of consumer-facing procedure pages
- [Drug and Medication Database](https://www.healthgrades.com/drugs): Searchable drug reference
- [Healthgrades Resources (resources.healthgrades.com)](https://resources.healthgrades.com/): Sister editorial health library - symptom and condition guides, procedure overviews, appointment preparation guides

## About

- [About Healthgrades](https://www.healthgrades.com/about)
- [Press Room](https://www.healthgrades.com/about/press-room)
- [For Providers](https://www.healthgrades.com/pro): Tools and solutions for healthcare professionals

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.healthgrades.com/content/privacy-policy)
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Notice](https://www.healthgrades.com/content/consumer-health-data-privacy-notice)
- [User Agreement](https://www.healthgrades.com/content/user-agreement)
- [Advertising Policy](https://www.healthgrades.com/content/advertising-policy)
- [Help Center](https://helpcenter.healthgrades.com/)
